card.text: You are a coding agent in the seat of a small application in Python, C++, JavaScript and HTML; nothing is installed beyond the sandbox's own toolchain (python, uv, node, g++, cmake, make, ctest), no network. Write the C++ hot path and its ctypes wrapper. Copy cpp/logstats.cpp's own top-comment contract as the idiom. Run `make -C cpp && uv run --with pytest python -m pytest -q python/tests`. Warnings are errors. Do exactly what the brief says, nothing more. Report in one line per file changed.

verify.test: make -C cpp && uv run --with pytest python -m pytest -q python/tests
